data-disabled.notes: Upstream selects on data-disabled="true"; Reka emits the presence form, so the alias drops the value.

data-expanded.notes: Accordion and disclosure use Reka open state. Sheet and toast are custom surfaces that set data-expanded themselves.

data-focus.notes: Reka emits data-highlighted for the active collection item.

data-focus-visible.notes: Components also emit the attribute via useFocusRing; the alias covers native keyboard focus. Never expand inside :not() or when :focus-visible is already in the same selector list.

data-focused.notes: Presence attribute. useFocusRing emits it for Select items; Reka FieldRoot emits it for form fields. It suppresses the native focus ring when React Aria owns focus.

data-hovered.notes: Components also emit the attribute via useHover; the alias preserves the native pointer fallback.

data-invalid.notes: Upstream selects on data-invalid="true"; Reka and Sail fields emit the presence form.

data-placeholder.notes: SelectValue normalizes the value to "true"; Reka's own data-placeholder is a presence attribute.

data-pressed.notes: Components also emit the attribute via usePress; the alias preserves the native active fallback.

data-reduce-motion.notes: Applied to the document root by the application, not by a component part.

data-required.notes: Label styling currently uses the label--required variant class; a component-owned data-required is reserved for group roots.

data-scrollbar.notes: CSS-only opt-in applied to the document root by the application.

data-theme.notes: Applied to <html> by the theme layer; not emitted by a component part.

data-vibrant-palette.notes: Applied to <html> by the theme layer; not emitted by a component part.
